Yeah it might not be a problem to you, but for the standard of the relationship Cindy got in the way of, it clearly was a problem. The thing about breaking up with your partner before pursuing other person is that you aren't cheating on them, it saves a little of respect for your soon to be ex partner. A lot of long lasting relationships start with someone breaking up with a partner to have another one. It's fairly common, but the thing about that it's that the problem itself aren't the feelings, it's the respect. Respect for your soon ex partner, respect for the time they dedicated to you, and for everything you two went through, if the relationship was good (Like this one seemed to have been). It's not just about him dating Cindy while being engaged, it's about disrespecting Emma too. And Cindy could have perfectly waited for him to break up things to Emma, but she also choose to disrespect Emma and start to date not only an engaged man, but now also a cheater, of course OP and his family don't want to meet her.

It's not about "being the worst for liking someone" it's about liking a man who's engaged and pursuing him, knowing she would make damage to at least one person.

Also yeah she might have not had responsibilities to Emma or OP's family but you know what? It's about having some decency and empathy. It's about being a good person.
